title: Draft a one-page comparison of three fictional meeting rooms
original_intent: Choose a room for 20 people, with step-free access, within GBP150. Explain the choice using the supplied fictional data.
outcome: One readable comparison page with a recommendation and a small comparison table; linked CSV companion.
scope_boundary: Use only the supplied fictional dataset. No booking, payment, personal data or claim about real venues. This is a sample definition, not an approved Jira task.

inputs.check: SHA-256 a8c7a885869020caefef5d7bd690f6acb2aa770fe07bde62bceb8f90157ac9e8; verify all three rows and required fields.

acceptance.criterion: Compare all three rooms on seats, step-free access and price; recommend only a room meeting all three requirements.
acceptance.method: Recompute the criteria from each source row and check the written recommendation.

acceptance.criterion: Give an independent reviewer the original request, full candidate and data; resolve supported findings, preserving disagreements.
acceptance.method: Actual second AI CLI reviews supplied sources; producer adjudicates and repeats within the remaining allowance.
acceptance.evidence: Full review/correction record and native run metadata in Confluence.

acceptance.criterion: Publish complete readable text and any visuals or registered placeholders to Confluence; exact companion version in GitHub.
acceptance.method: Read saved text, links and visuals; check every placeholder against the separate inventory.
acceptance.evidence: Canonical page and attachment versions, inventory IDs or explicit nil return, immutable commit and file hash.
